question: How do the observed mouse values, within-study differences and leave-one-mouse ranges compare for the eight specified flanking CpGs?
decision: Display the owner-reviewed frozen comparison at the numerical checkpoint.
strongest_rival: The same change can arise on very different baselines, while overlapping points or pooling sites could hide individual variation.
discriminator: Plot all 96 mouse values, 16 full differences and their omission ranges, with fragment labels and the saved site classifications.
exposure_record: The frozen numerical comparison is complete and visible. This outcome-exposed render uses all rows in fixed order. No new estimand, selection or stability criterion.
biological_unit: An individual mouse in one of two separate studies. Three mice per arm per study. The same animals contribute multiple CpGs; five fragments group the eight sites.
nesting_and_overlap: Two separate cohorts, no matched individuals. Stage 1 source slices and earlier qualification are reused. Sites and fragments are not independent mouse replicates.
population_and_selection: Exactly eight prior probe IDs at three left and five right flank dyads. Six specified GSE283386 saline mice (3 DSS, 3 water) and six GSE316762 DMSO mice (3 recovered, 3 healthy).
contrast: Already measured methylation percent and DSS-minus-control percentage points, separated by study.
endpoint: One multipanel academic figure in vector PDF and 300-dpi PNG with black text and output checks.
methods: Within each genomic fragment, display each fixed probe. Show both study-specific animal distributions and group means in percent, study-specific full effects, min/max of six one-mouse omissions, and saved directional classifications. Use the article gallery black DejaVu Sans regular and bold font. Verify all eight probe labels, font, color and page bounds.
missingness_and_exclusions: Accept zero and preserve exact deposited decimals. Halt for provenance review if an expected specimen/coordinate is duplicated or unavailable. No replacements or outcomes-driven filtering.
multiplicity: Display only; no new effect estimates.
precision_basis: Observed mice and one-mouse omission ranges, not sampling uncertainty intervals.
interpretation_limit: The graphic describes measured markers and mouse sensitivity. Stop at the numerical checkpoint for owner scientific review.
stop_rule: Stop for review if any probe or legend is lost or figure integrity fails.
amendment_reason: Requested gallery-style rendering of the preceding frozen numerical outputs.
